_meta.note: Captured off the wire: the tool-call frames of one real turn, `opencode acp` 1.18.30 driving a local Ollama model. A SLICE, not the whole turn -- the 430 agent_message_chunk frames the model emitted between them are omitted for length, and the frames kept are verbatim apart from the home directory, replaced with ~ per ../README.md. The call FAILED, and that is real too: the model passed timeout as a string, so the harness rejected the arguments against its own schema. Nothing ran, and the rejection happens before any permission check -- which is why this turn carries no session/request_permission frame. The turn ran past the recorder's deadline, so its terminal frame is in session-live.jsonl rather than here.
